Fixture provenance

Status and inbox lines come from the redesign samples 03/04, supplemented by
full S2/S4/S5 records supplied by Firstmate in the build task's real-records/.
Only relevant transitions are retained; existing truncated lines stay truncated.
Supplemental inbox records retain only their verbatim headers through --.
Sample 04 excerpts retain the body text that sample copied.
The ship metadata is fixture scaffolding, not a historical claim.

servora-s15-ics-feed.status is RECONSTRUCTED, from samples/06b and
fixture-servora-s15-ics-feed.status: the original status log was removed.
Its block epoch is real; its note is the contemporaneously quoted pipeline
message, not a claim to the lost line's exact wording.

The legacy sample 03 S6 contains four of the six untimed blocked lines cited
in the report; this fixture includes exactly those four lines.
The reopen test adds timestamps to those real legacy lines, as the design asks.
Sidecars retain copied sample lines (the outcome sample is TSV, not JSON).
Trailing whitespace at excerpt boundaries is trimmed.
They are used as ignored classifier inputs, not loaded as a valid outcome store.
